verdict.rationale: Lithic documents dated API versions selected with an `api-version` request header, which lets integrators control when changes reach their integration. That covers the versioning half of the story well. No evidence shows a formal deprecation policy with notice periods, sunset timelines or support windows. The legacy-webhook-to-Events-API migration guide only shows ad hoc transition handling, such as keeping the same schema and temporarily sharing HMAC headers. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, a version support-window guarantee, and independent corroboration of versioning stability.
